name: 25_window_on_terminal
description: A transfer window whose book would really clear (b1 asks 40 units, b5 bids 40 at the same price → 40 units supply-limited) is mid-settlement when the series goes terminal. finalize_window is forced down the NoMatch path and process_orders refunds every order — no non-consensual trade on a dead series (S3 / C-S5). Shown on both a Redeemed (S1) and an Extinguished (S2) series: the ask units return to b1, the bid escrow returns to b5, and no units change hands.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: the series is redeemed while the (crossing) window is still mid-flight
a proposal at 120 that would clear 40 units on a live series
series terminal → forced WindowNoMatch (S3 / C-S5), not WindowCleared
every order refunded: b1's 40 units returned, b5's escrow returned; no trade
Redeemed series: window NoMatched, b1 holds its 40 back (100 total), b5 refunded in full, zero units traded
the series is extinguished while the (crossing) window is mid-flight
b1's 40 units returned, b5's escrow returned
Extinguished series: same — window NoMatched, nothing traded, every order made whole
